caption_L1: Here a area plot is named American customer satisfaction index scores of Pizza Hut restaurants in the United States from 2000 to 2020. A linear scale from 2000 to 2015 can be seen on the x-axis, marked Year. The y-axis measures ACSI score.
caption_L2L3: The chart shows that customer satisfaction seems to fluctuate on a regular basis however the trend is for rising satisfaction levels overall. Satisfaction has risen from around 70 in 2000 to around 75 in 2020 with 2010 and 2014 both reaching figures of over 80.
